_comment: gear_module=1.0, pinion 11T, spur 66T. Centre distance comes from BOSL2 gear_dist() = 38.845 mm, not m*(z1+z2)/2 = 38.5: the 11T pinion gets an automatic profile shift of 0.357 (P29, 2026-11-27; at 38.5 the teeth jammed and an earlier 0.5-2.0 mm interference window hid it). motion_sweep.py checks the distance itself from "module". With the phase in params.scad the teeth interleave with backlash 0.15, so no overlap is allowed. Meshing external gears turn opposite ways: spur ratio = -(11/66).

contacts.derivation: correct centre distance + phase leave backlash, so real teeth do not overlap; 0.05 mm is mesh noise
